test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the given expression.

12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.8 × 1.03)]
solution:
**Given:**

12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.8 × 1.03)]

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

**Calculation:**

12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.8 × 1.03)]

⇒ 12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.914)]

⇒ 12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of 1.686]

⇒ 12.3 - [7 + 1.3488]

⇒ 12.3 - 8.3488

⇒ 3.9512

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
